sloka: वर्तमाने तदा घोरे सङ्ग्रामे भृशदारुणे ।इन्द्रजित्तु रथं त्यक्त्वा हताश्वो हतसारथिः ।अङ्गदेन महाकायस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।। ६.४४.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: vartamāne tadā ghore saṅgrāme bhṛśadāruṇe ।indrajittu rathaṁ tyaktvā hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ ।aṅgadena mahākāyastatraivāntaradhīyata ।। 6.44.29 ।।।।

translations.english: As the violent war was going on, the great cheat, Indrajith disappeared from there as Angada had already killed his horses and charioteer.
